scientific_integrity: Claims are conditional on the published integrality, dimension and exact singular-point classification; finite symbolic checking is supplementary to the dimension-theoretic proof. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies graded local rings and reduced-point blowups, not completed analytic germs or nonreduced Jacobian blowups. Historical priority remains qualified because Horadam (1957) could not be inspected in full.
title: One thousand eighty Segre tangent cones on the Heisenberg-invariant theta fourfold
